definitions.explanation: Something happening without one being aware of when or how.

examples.japanese: いつの{間|ま}にか⟦{眠|ねむ}ってしまった→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧。
examples.english: I fell asleep before I knew it.

examples.japanese: いつの{間|ま}にか⟦{大|おお}きくなった→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
examples.english: You've grown up before I realized it.

examples.japanese: いつの{間|ま}にか⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|や}んでいた→止む：01153_yamu⟧。
examples.english: The rain had stopped without me noticing.

examples.japanese: いつの{間|ま}にか⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わっていた→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The season had changed without me realizing.

examples.japanese: いつの{間|ま}にか⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: My Japanese improved without me realizing it.

examples.japanese: いつの{間|ま}にか⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦{帰|かえ}っていた→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: Before I knew it, everyone around me had gone home.

notes:
いつの{間|ま}にか expresses something happening without awareness.

USAGE:
- Often used with past tense
- Implies gradual or unnoticed change
- Common in everyday conversation

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- いつの{間|ま}にか: before one knows it (unaware)
- {知|し}らないうちに: without knowing
- {気|き}がつけば: when I noticed

WRITING:
- {間|ま} is usually written with kanji
- いつのまにか (all hiragana) also acceptable
